plan.description: Reads plan.md, tasks.md, requirements.md and breaks work into atomic shippable tasks. Maintains task status tracking across phases.

review.description: Reviews code against ArcGIS non-negotiable rules, TypeScript strict mode, and design system tokens. Catches violations before commit.

dev.description: Start Vite dev server and Express API server concurrently for full local environment

seed.description: Seed the PostgreSQL database with initial data from db/seed.sql

migrate.description: Apply database schema from db/init.sql to PostgreSQL

build-check.description: Run TypeScript type-check and Vite build

lint-fix.description: Run ESLint with auto-fix on all source files
